_about: acrylonitrile (1) + water (2): the two liquids in equilibrium measured in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's records (bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes (proposal 0019, step 2). Rows: T in K, P in kPa (null where the record gives none), mole fraction of component 1 in liquid I and in liquid II, index of the record in records.

records.citation: X. Zhang, C. Jian, Liquid liquid equilibrium for the ternary systems of water + methanol  + acrylonitrile, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 142-147
